criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Although the action history asserts the agent found and used a “Best sellers” list, the screenshots do not provide visual confirmation that the agent ever reached a “Best sellers” section. With no blocker shown (site loads fine; scrolling possible), this is a controllable evidence gap. Award partial credit for navigating to the Xbox games area, but not full credit for reaching “Best sellers.”

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open a valid Xbox.com product page (confirmed). But because there is no visual evidence that the game was selected from a “Best sellers” section, only partial credit is warranted under the criterion’s traceability requirement.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All three requested fields are visible on the product page in the screenshot, so the information was available and verifiable. However, the agent’s predicted output incorrectly claimed the publisher value was not visible and failed to report it, contradicting the screenshot. This is a substantive omission/contradiction, so deduct accordingly.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints were respected: no sign-in, no buying, no downloading. The agent effectively stopped after attempting to record the required fields. Full credit.
